definitions: A contagious bacterial infection of the eye, caused by Chlamydia trachomatis, that can lead to blindness.
A chronic inflammatory disease of the conjunctiva and cornea, characterized by the formation of follicles and scarring.
examples: Trachoma is a leading cause of preventable blindness worldwide.
Public health initiatives aim to eradicate Trachoma.
The patient was diagnosed with Trachoma.
